question: In a ΔPMN, ∠P = 76°. The bisectors of the exterior angles at M and N intersect each other at point O. The degree measure of ∠MON is:
solution:
**Given:**

In ΔPMN, ∠P = 76°

Bisectors of the exterior angles at M and N intersect at O

**Formula used:**

Exterior angle bisectors of a triangle intersect at 90° - (∠P/2)

Where ∠P is third angle of the triangle.

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4cbca94824a70c51f1f00eff287f984d48cb5f7e2af2d23fe7729566b1490edf.png] 

∠P = 76°

⇒ ∠MON = 90° - (∠P/2)

⇒ ∠MON = 90° - (76°/2)

⇒ ∠MON = 90° - 38°

⇒ ∠MON = 52°

**Hence, the correct answer is option (2).**
